candidateActions.action: Give the existing browser-project guide a direct path from its evidence and fixtures to a runnable train/evaluate example and visible held-out comparison.
candidateActions.evidence: Official TF.js tutorials recur in 10 answered observations across 8 prompts. Two inspected browser-training answers point to practical libraries and a code workflow.
candidateActions.uncertainty: The guide and linked lessons already teach preprocessing and evaluation. The newly released direct reproduction links must be included in the before/after assessment. Citation selection and indexing, not a missing concept, may explain absence.

candidateActions.action: Add a sourced comparison with Coursera's Browser-based Models with TensorFlow.js to the existing comparison page.
candidateActions.evidence: Gemini and Google AI Overview name and cite the same course. Its primary page states intermediate level, prior TensorFlow recommendation, four modules and browser/Python-conversion scope. Existing /compare omits it.
candidateActions.uncertainty: The signal comes from one course prompt. A comparison improves reader fit but does not guarantee citations. Do not infer quality or outcomes.

candidateActions.status: Defer until fit and submission rules verified
candidateActions.action: Check whether Class Central accepts TensorFlow.js course listings in an appropriate category.
candidateActions.evidence: Gemini cites the ml5.js directory once. Tensorcraft was absent in the retrieved page text, and a public contact page exists.
candidateActions.uncertainty: The cited ml5 category does not match Tensorcraft's TF.js course. New-course acceptance policy and eligible category are unverified. No outreach was sent.

candidateActions.action: Prepare a distinctive, technically verified browser ML example before qualifying a relevant editorial contribution route.
candidateActions.evidence: The course answer cites freeCodeCamp's ml5.js course announcement. Other tutorial publishers appear in the sources.
candidateActions.uncertainty: The cited announcement promotes its own course. This is not evidence that the publisher will add Tensorcraft. No verified contribution route or recurring editorial placement opportunity yet.

candidateActions.action: Avoid duplicating basic normalization or reshape instruction before assessing existing lessons and guides.
candidateActions.evidence: Owned-side reads show a reshape guide with runnable code and free normalization lesson with training-only statistics and reuse.
candidateActions.uncertainty: No observed citation identifies a missing explanation. An indexing or authority problem remains possible.

limitations: One observation per manually selected neutral prompt and engine. Findings describe this run only, not all AI use, ranking, traffic, conversions or prompt demand.
All topics have zero recorded mentions and citations. There is no strongest or weakest visibility topic within this sample. Coverage differs.
No competitor brands were configured. Provider competitor-gap counts cannot rank alternatives. Named alternatives above come only from the six inspected answers.
All 36 observation rows and all 143 exact URL rows were retrieved. Each page and source row reported truncated=false. Six selected full answers reported truncated=false.
Exact URL variants are preserved. Domain-level answer totals deduplicate observation IDs and remove only an initial www. prefix. Subdomains remain separate.

Twenty-three source rows contain unresolved Google redirect URLs. Their final destinations were not independently verified. Zero own citations is OpenSEO's recorded brand result, not a claim that every redirect target was inspected.
Two upstream failures are not no-answer results and are not brand absence. No retries were purchased.
Extra explore_prompt and paid search research were skipped because authorization was limited to the exact $0.216 manual check. No fan-out or search-causality claims.
This first run has no comparable historical baseline. No trend is claimed.
Provider responses did not return an actual credit debit. The exact approved run cap was $0.216, quoted as 216 credits. Schedule is disabled before and after collection.
